title: Past perfect simple / continuous
recall: Past perfect qachon kerak? Simple va continuous farqini by the time bilan bitta misolda ayt.
formula: had + V3: o'tmishdagi nuqtadan OLDIN tugagan — When I arrived, the film had started
had been + -ing: o'tmishdagi nuqtagacha davom etgan — She was tired because she had been working all day
by the time, before, after, already, just, never… before

pairs.a: When I arrived, the film started.
pairs.b: When I arrived, the film had started.
pairs.note_uz: birga boshlandi ↔ men kelganda allaqachon boshlangan edi

pairs.b: I had been reading for two hours.

items.uz: Men kelganimda film boshlanib bo'lgan edi.
en: When I arrived, the film had already started.
The film had already started when I arrived.
When I arrived, the film had started.
The film had started when I arrived.

items.uz: Avtobus ketib qolgan edi, shuning uchun piyoda bordim.
en: The bus had left, so I walked.
The bus had already left, so I walked.

items.uz: U ilgari hech qachon samolyotda uchmagan edi.
en: Malika had never flown before.
Malika had never been on a plane before.

items.uz: Men u bilan tanishishdan oldin uni ko'p eshitgan edim. (Ali haqida)
en: I had heard a lot about Ali before I met him.
Before I met Ali, I had heard a lot about him.

items.uz: Ish soat 9 ga qadar tugab bo'lgan edi.
en: The work had finished by 9.
The work had been finished by 9.
The work had been done by 9.

items.uz: Ko'zlari qizarib ketgan edi — u yig'layotgan ekan.
en: Her eyes were red because she had been crying.
Her eyes were red; she had been crying.

items.uz: Men ikki soatdan beri kutayotgan edim, keyin u keldi.
en: I had been waiting for two hours when he came.
I had been waiting for two hours when he arrived.
I had been waiting for 2 hours when he came.

items.uz: Yer ho'l edi, chunki tun bo'yi yomg'ir yog'gan edi.
en: The ground was wet because it had been raining all night.
The ground was wet because it had rained all night.

items.uz: Men uyga kelganimda hamma uxlab qolgan edi.
en: When I got home, everyone had gone to bed.
When I came home, everyone had fallen asleep.
When I got home, everyone had fallen asleep.

items.uz: U kelguncha biz ovqatlanib bo'lgan edik.
en: By the time he arrived, we had eaten.
By the time he came, we had already eaten.
By the time he arrived, we had already eaten.

items.uz: Men kalitimni uyda qoldirganimni tushundim.
en: I realised I had left my key at home.
I realized that I had left my key at home.
I realised that I had left my keys at home.

items.uz: U 10 yil ishlagandan keyin nafaqaga chiqdi.
en: He retired after he had worked for 10 years.
He retired after he had been working for 10 years.
After he had worked for 10 years, he retired.

items.uz: Shuncha yugurgandan keyin charchagan edim.
en: I was tired because I had been running.
I was tired because I had been running so much.

items.uz: Bu filmni oldin ko'rgan edingmi?
en: Had you seen this film before?
Had you seen this movie before?

items.uz: Do'konga yetib borganimda u yopilib bo'lgan edi.
en: When I got to the shop, it had closed.
The shop had closed when I got there.
When I got to the shop, it had already closed.

items.uz: U menga oldin u yerda ishlaganini aytdi.
en: He told me he had worked there before.
He told me that he had worked there before.

items.uz: Biz uchrashishdan oldin xat yozishib turgan edik.
en: We had been writing to each other before we met.
We had been writing letters to each other before we met.

items.uz: U imtihondan o'tolmadi, chunki tayyorlanmagan edi.
en: He failed the exam because he hadn't prepared.
He failed the exam because he had not prepared.

items.uz: Men hech qachon bunday chiroyli joyni ko'rmagan edim.
en: I had never seen such a beautiful place.
I had never seen such a beautiful place before.

items.uz: Qancha vaqtdan beri kutayotgan eding, u kelganida?
en: How long had you been waiting when he came?
How long had you been waiting when he arrived?

speak: Kecha nima bo'ldi va undan OLDIN nima bo'lgan edi? 5 ta gap.
Charchagan, xursand yoki asabiy bo'lgan bir kuningiz: nima sababdan edi? (had been -ing)
Hikoya: by the time … had … bilan 3 ta gap.
